test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

That's is the _______ man I was telling you about, he was the one following me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes **a man who was being followed.**
 
• The word "**bald**" fits the context as it describes the man's appearance.
 
• Other options such as "**bawled", "balled", and "bailed"** do not fit the context of describing a man.
 
• Thus, the correct word to fill the blank is "**bald**".
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"That's the **bald** man I was telling you about, he was the one following me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **bawled:** means to cry loudly.
 
• **balled:** means formed into a ball.
 
• **bald:** means having no hair on the scalp.
 
• **bailed:** means to release someone from custody by providing bail.
